_comment: Manual verdicts for findings the mechanical labeller marked FP (not on a truth line). Single labeller (the fixer agent), NOT blind, NOT double-labelled: the plan's blind two-labeller step (section 6.2) is still to do. Only unlisted-real / undecidable need an entry; every other non-TP stays FP with the default reason. Rev 1b (2026-11-21): the two ZAP-key verdicts changed from FP to unlisted-real.

app/routes/session.js:143:secure-coding/.reason: EMAIL_RE = /^[\S]+@[\S]+\.[\S]+$/ is reachable from unauthenticated POST /signup (email is regex-tested after the other fields pass; email has no length cap). Input '@'.repeat(n) fails the match after quadratic backtracking: measured 2000 chars 2 ms, 4000 chars 8 ms, 8000 chars 31 ms (Node 24, V8 irregexp), so a 100 KB body (body-parser default limit) costs about 5 s of event-loop time. A real, undocumented ReDoS.

config/env/development.js:6:secure-codin.reason: zapApiKey is a committed random-looking 26-character literal (a hard-coded credential in source). Label corrected from FP on the coordinator's review (2026-11-21, rev 1b). Impact is bounded (a local OWASP ZAP scanner key in developer configs, not documented in the NodeGoat tutorial), so it is unlisted-real, not a truth-table hit: strict precision still counts it as FP, lenient counts it as TP.
